answer: A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the atlas graph. Re-attestations are stored in thread and voyage lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, which means holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 1722 identities would post 1651 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
